train_music_translation_model: train a universal music translation network using WaveNet encoder decoder and Z discriminator
evaluate_translation_model: evaluate the trained music translation model on validation data and log reconstruction losses
save_model_checkpoint: save the encoder decoder and discriminator model states along with optimizer states to disk
load_model_checkpoint: load a previously saved model checkpoint including encoder decoder discriminator and optimizer states
run_distributed_training: run distributed training across multiple GPUs using PyTorch DistributedDataParallel with NCCL backend
